rationale: Record that the stale-CLI guard crosses the design-source-ingest selector through the shared CLI reference and agent guidance. The Rust pulp CLI now re-runs build/dev/loop/run/test through a Pulp checkout's own build/pulp, or refuses, when the running CLI is more than 50 releases behind the project, and a SessionStart hook reports the same gap. No importer, DesignIR schema, browser capture path, renderer, codegen output, fixture, threshold or Vellum-owned source changes, and no existing test's verdict changes. Registered as watch-only so the family's coverage stays honest about a change that crossed its selector. No authority moves and no Vellum artifact changes.
